scope: Online manual and scheduled PostgreSQL + registered ready local media + configuration/program package; no business write freeze

implementation.business_writes: Removed global SnapshotMutationGuard, admission flock and table SHARE locks; normal coordinator capture never calls Stop/Start or enters maintenance
implementation.database_boundary: Repeatable Read read-only pg_export_snapshot; pg_dump --snapshot and media references share transaction; captured_at comes from database statement timestamp
implementation.media: Ready undeleted media_assets and media_asset_variants only; strict SHA256 and size; directory-FD traversal denies symlinks; opened inode survives rename/unlink; incomplete/unregistered uploads excluded
implementation.retry: Same persistent snapshot id, bounded 4 attempts with 5/15/45 second backoff; each attempt clears incomplete content and exports a fresh MVCC point; retry_wait, attempt, retry_at delivered via existing SSE
implementation.maintenance: Explicit formal cutover and its rollback capture retain maintenance; ordinary online packages never claim a frozen Redis recovery contract
